source_row.rationale: Normal fasting blood glucose is generally below 100 mg/dL, per ADA criteria. A value of 92 mg/dL falls within this normal range, distinct from prediabetes (fasting glucose 100-125 mg/dL) or diabetes (fasting glucose ≥126 mg/dL on two occasions).
source_row.source_name: American Diabetes Association — Standards of Care, Diagnostic Criteria
